facts.business: Le Lavoir Limited operates in laundry processing services and agricultural business.

auditor.name: M/s. Sunit M Chhatbar & Co, Chartered Accountants, Rajkot

key_risks: Operational Risk: Equipment failure, utility interruptions or delays in maintenance may affect laundry processing capacity and timely service delivery.
Customer Risk: Dependence on a limited number of major institutional customers may impact revenues in the event of contract termination, reduced volumes or delayed renewals.

Commodity and Agricultural Risk: Changes in agricultural commodity prices, seasonal availability, crop yields, adverse weather conditions, pest attacks and other factors affecting agricultural production may impact procurement costs, availability and profitability.

Regulatory, Environmental and Food Safety Risk: Changes in environmental, wastewater treatment, labour, occupational safety, food safety, quality and other applicable regulatory requirements across the laundry and agricultural businesses may increase compliance obligations and operating costs.
facts.related_party_note: During the year under review, the Company has entered into transactions with its related parties in the ordinary course of business and on an arm's length basis. All such transactions were undertaken in compliance with the applicable provisions of the Companies Act, 2013 and the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, as applicable. The transactions entered into by the Company with its related parties fall within the scope of Section 188(1) of the Companies Act, 2013 and were carried out on an arm's length basis and in the ordinary course of business. The transactions did not have any potential conflict with the interests of the Company.
